import {execFileSync,spawnSync} from 'node:child_process'; import {readFileSync,readdirSync} from 'node:fs'; import test from 'node:test'; import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; const {extractPrecacheUrls}=await import('./scripts/check-precache-budget.mjs'); const urls=extractPrecacheUrls(readFileSync('dist/sw.js','utf8')); const counts=Object.fromEntries(['Assets','Workers','Widgets','ThirdParty'].map(dir=>[dir,urls.filter(url=>url.startsWith('cesium/'+dir+'/')).length])); console.log('Manifest diagnostics',JSON.stringify({entries:urls.length,cesium:counts,rendererJs:readdirSync('dist/assets').filter(x=>x.endsWith('.js')).length})); test('built manifest includes the real Cesium assets, workers, widgets and third-party files',()=>{assert.ok(Object.values(counts).every(n=>n>0),'Missing production Cesium precache');}); test('production build passes the unmodified npm precache budget',()=>{const p=spawnSync('npm',['run','pwa:budget'],{encoding:'utf8'}); console.log(p.stdout); assert.equal(p.status,0,(p.stdout+p.stderr).match(/Error: [^\n]+/)?.[0]??p.stderr);});
